overview.title: State-of-the-art residential education for the boy child.
paragraphs: Merishaw School is a residential boys' high school offering the National Curriculum under 8.4.4 and Competency-Based Education at Junior and Senior Secondary School.
The school develops unique programs to bring up wholesome young men who can meet the needs of society and provide leadership in their families, workplaces, the country, and the global stage.
The approach emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, academic excellence, character formation, and the restoration of focus on the boy child.

about.vision: To develop purpose driven global leaders empowered for success.
about.mission: Merishaw aims to provide a world class education that equips learners with skills to become critical thinkers, effective communicators, God fearing, and compassionate leaders with integrity through the pursuit of academic excellence.

architecture.title: Built as a home away from home.
architecture.description: Merishaw's campus is designed to feel calm, ordered, and inspiring, with the facilities and environment learners need to fully enjoy school life.

programs.title: 8.4.4 Curriculum
programs.description: Merishaw offers the 8.4.4 system with a focus on academic excellence, character development, practical skills, and preparation for KCSE and tertiary transitions.

programs.title: Competency-Based Education
programs.description: The school offers Junior and Senior Secondary learning under CBE, helping learners grow as critical thinkers, effective communicators, and responsible lifelong learners.

programs.title: Holistic Boarding Experience
programs.description: A safe and caring residential environment supports academics, mentorship, sports, spiritual growth, creativity, and disciplined independence.

studentCouncil.quote: Merishaw School promotes resilience and growth. The teamwork, commitment, and enthusiasm displayed by students, staff, and parents is truly commendable.
The school is homely and provides the ideal environment for students to thrive, from an exhilarating academic environment to competitions and international exposure.
